quotes.text: After the import UI rebuild, category-based nsIImportService module discovery and name/support metadata were dead. This cleanup leaves nsIImportModule.GetImportInterface and direct contract-ID construction. The tests changed from searching names to Cc[aContractID].createInstance(Ci.nsIImportModule); current importer tests and Outlook profile importer still use direct construction. Do not reintroduce the removed registry discovery for a new importer.
